class SubPipelines(unittest.TestCase):
    DEFS = {
        "Normalize": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "z", "expr": "(value - params.mean) / params.std"}]},
        "KeepCols": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "z"]}]},
    }

    def test_basic_call_with_params(self):
        code, out = run_cli(request(
            [{"op": "call", "name": "Normalize", "params": {"mean": 100, "std": 20}},
             {"op": "call", "name": "KeepCols", "params": {}}],
            [{"id": 1, "value": 120}, {"id": 2, "value": 80}], defs=self.DEFS,
        ), args=["--execute"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["data"], [{"id": 1, "z": 1}, {"id": 2, "z": -1}])
        self.assertEqual(out["metrics"], {"rows_in": 2, "rows_out": 2})

    def test_normalized_includes_defs_only_when_given(self):
        code, out = run_cli(request([{"op": "call", "name": "KeepCols"}], defs=self.DEFS))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["normalized"]["steps"], [{"op": "call", "name": "KeepCols", "params": {}}])
        self.assertEqual(set(out["normalized"]["defs"]), {"Normalize", "KeepCols"})
        code, out = run_cli(request([{"op": "limit", "n": 1}]))
        self.assertEqual(out["normalized"], {"steps": [{"op": "limit", "n": 1}]})

        code, out = run_cli(request([{"op": "call", "name": "Missing", "params": {}}], [{"id": 1}], defs={}),
                            args=["--execute"])
        self.assertEqual((code, out["error_code"], out["path"]), (1, "UNKNOWN_DEF", "pipeline.steps[0].name"))

    def test_names_are_case_sensitive(self):
        code, out = run_cli(request([{"op": "call", "name": "keepcols"}], defs=self.DEFS))
        self.assertEqual(out["error_code"], "UNKNOWN_DEF")

    def test_direct_recursion(self):
        defs = {"Loop": {"steps": [{"op": "call", "name": "Loop", "params": {}}]}}
        code, out = run_cli(request([{"op": "call", "name": "Loop"}], [{"id": 1}], defs=defs), args=["--execute"])
        self.assertEqual((code, out["error_code"], out["path"]), (1, "RECURSION_FORBIDDEN", "defs[Loop].steps[0].name"))

    def test_indirect_recursion_in_unused_defs(self):

            "B": {"steps": [{"op": "call", "name": "A"}]},
        }
        code, out = run_cli(request([], defs=defs))
        self.assertEqual((out["error_code"], out["path"]), ("RECURSION_FORBIDDEN", "defs[B].steps[0].name"))

### Sub-pipelines (`defs` / `call`)

- Top-level `defs` is an optional object `{Name: {"steps": [...]}}`; names are
  case-sensitive. `{"op":"call","name":N,"params":{...}}` runs `defs[N].steps`
  in place of the call. `name` must match `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`;
  `params` defaults to `{}` and its values may be scalars or arrays (objects,
  also inside arrays, are `SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED` at `...params.<key>`).
- Expressions read parameters with `params.<key>`; unbound keys are `null`.
  `params` is reserved: a bare `params` is `BAD_EXPR` and row fields named
  `params` cannot be read. Parameters are not inherited by nested calls.
- Every definition is normalized (in declaration order, before the main
  pipeline) even when unused, without column tracking. Unknown targets are
  `UNKNOWN_DEF` and any call cycle is `RECURSION_FORBIDDEN`, both at the
  calling step's `.name`. Errors inside a definition use
  `defs[Name].steps[k]...`.
- In normalize-only mode a call carries the column tracker through the
  definition's steps, so missing columns are reported at the def path.
- `normalized` gains a `defs` key only when the request has `defs`.
EOF
